d: The Identity, Data Protection & Secrets Security Engineer is the onsite owner of the client's data loss prevention (Symantec DLP), multi-factor authentication (Thales SafeNet) and secrets-management (HashiCorp Vault) platforms. The role protects sensitive data, user authentication and application secrets through well-governed policies, controlled exceptions and reliable platform operations.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related discipline.
7+ years in IT/security, of which 4+ years in security engineering.
Relevant certifications such as Symantec/Broadcom DLP Administrator, HashiCorp Certified: Vault Associate/Operations Professional and Thales SafeNet administrator training.
CyberArk Defender (PAM-DEF) and Microsoft AZ-800/801 (AD CS) certifications are an added advantage.
CISSP, CISM or Security+ certifications are an added advantage.
Strong hands-on experience administering and tuning Symantec DLP across endpoint, network and email channels in enterprise environments.
Hands-on experience operating Thales SafeNet MFA (or comparable enterprise MFA), including RADIUS/SAML integrations.
Working experience administering HashiCorp Vault (or comparable secrets-management platforms), including application onboarding and HA/recovery.
Strong technical knowledge of Symantec DLP, including Enforce server, detection servers, Endpoint agents, Network Monitor/Prevent for Web and Email, and detection methods (DCM, EDM, IDM, VML).

Experience with Thales SafeNet MFA, including token lifecycle (hardware, software, push), authentication policies, RADIUS/SAML/LDAP integrations and agents for Windows logon, VPN and web applications.

Experience with HashiCorp Vault, including KV, PKI, database and dynamic secrets engines; authentication methods (AppRole, LDAP, Kubernetes, OIDC); ACL policies; Raft storage, HA, DR and performance replication.
Knowledge of Active Directory/LDAP, Linux/Windows administration, scripting (Python/Bash/PowerShell) and REST APIs.
Exposure to CyberArk PAM, Microsoft PKI (AD CS), Imperva DAM, Splunk Enterprise Security (SIEM) or Symantec Endpoint Security is a strong advantage.
Familiarity with BeyondTrust/Delinea is an added advantage.
Strong governance and compliance understanding, including least privilege, segregation of duties, access recertification and data classification.
Working knowledge of ITIL-based incident, problem and change management; experience in regulated environments (banking/payments/financial services) is an advantage.
Knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001/27002:2022, CIS Controls v8 and PCI DSS v4.0.1 as they apply to security platform operations.
Permanently resident and physically located in the UAE (mandatory).
Willingness to complete background verification, security clearance and confidentiality commitments before receiving privileged access
Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to produce clear RCA reports, runbooks and handover notes.
r: Create, tune and optimise detection rules and policies across Endpoint, Web/Network and Email channels; reduce false positives.
Build and maintain data identifiers and fingerprints (DCM, EDM, IDM) in line with the client's data classification.
Manage exception governance and policy exclusions through an approved process.
Support incident investigation, incident workflow/remediation troubleshooting, reporting and compliance evidence.
Deploy DLP agents and monitor agent health, connectivity and version; manage server-side upgrades, patching and configuration backup.
Support configuration management, user and token administration, enrolment, replacement and revocation.
Configure and tune authentication policies; integrate applications, VPN and Windows logon via RADIUS, SAML and agents.
Troubleshoot MFA integration, connectivity and synchronisation issues with directory services.
Perform firmware/lifecycle management, configuration backup, health checks, upgrades and migrations.
Administer Vault configuration, policies, users, applications and authentication methods; manage secrets engines and access policies.
Onboard applications and pipelines; support secret rotation, dynamic secrets and lease lifecycle.
Manage unseal/auto-unseal, HA and replication, snapshots, backup and recovery, patching and upgrades.
Perform health and connectivity checks; review audit logs; support integration troubleshooting.
Act as the named primary engineer for the assigned platforms; ensure all privileged administrative activity is performed under a named, recorded and attributable account.

Deliver all configuration changes strictly under the client change management process, including implementation, validation, rollback and evidence steps; emergency changes only under the pre-approved emergency procedure and documented retrospectively.
Handle incidents and service requests against the priority-based SLA model (P0–P4); perform Root Cause Analysis (P1 within 5 business days, P2 within 10 business days).
Coordinate with OEM/vendor support: case logging, tracking, escalation, patches, bug fixes and RMAs.
Maintain configuration baselines, hardening standards, configuration backups, asset records, architecture diagrams, SOPs and runbooks; update them after every material change.
Contribute to the monthly KPI/KRI report, quarterly health checks, the monthly Service Improvement Register and the quarterly service review.

Maintain a shared daily handover log with the other platform engineers (open incidents, in-flight changes, scheduled maintenance and known risks) and provide cover for the secondary platforms during the primary engineer's leave, sickness and public holidays.
Maintain working proficiency in all assigned technologies (primary and secondary) through runbooks and regular knowledge-transfer sessions with the primary owner.
Use any spare capacity for additional work on the same technologies (health-check remediation, optimisation and new-feature POCs) as agreed with the client.
Support regulatory, audit and evidence requests for the assigned platforms.
Perform out-of-hours work (approved maintenance windows and critical incidents) only as separately agreed with the client, with compensatory leave.

d: Job Title: Storekeeper cum Purchasing Clerk

We are looking for a reliable Storekeeper cum Purchasing Clerk to manage daily warehouse/store stock and handle purchasing tasks. You will be responsible for receiving deliveries, issuing stock to branches, keeping inventory records accurate, and buying supplies at the best prices.
q: 1–2 years of experience in storekeeping and purchasing (F&B, retail, or warehouse preferred).
Basic computer skills (Microsoft Excel and inventory/accounting software).
r: Receive, check, and store incoming goods properly (checking quantity, quality, and expiry dates).
Arrange stock neatly using FIFO/FEFO (oldest or nearest-expiry items used first).
Prepare and dispatch daily stock requests for branches/departments.
Update all stock-in and stock-out records in the system daily.
Conduct regular stock counts and report any damaged, missing, or near-expiry items.
Check low stock levels and prepare Purchase Orders (POs) for approval.
Contact suppliers, collect price quotes, and negotiate good rates and delivery times.
Follow up with suppliers to make sure orders arrive on time.
Match Purchase Orders, Delivery Notes, and Invoices before sending them to Accounts.
Keep an updated list of suppliers and item prices.
